name: sparx — Ceramics Studio (Modern)
tagline: A bright, design-forward storefront for a contemporary ceramics studio.
description: A complete, working shop for a contemporary ceramics studio: a real catalogue of modern tableware — a cylinder mug, nesting bowls, a coupe plate set, a carafe & cup, a tumbler set, two sculptural vases, a cylinder planter and a full table set, each in three house colours — with categories, collections, a crisp-on-white PDP and a fully merchandised home page. Bright cool-white theme, near-black ink and a single bold clay-coral accent, in a geometric grotesk with sharp corners. Shipped as Form.
